question: Should the built-in Orgo provider require an operator-managed workspace and permanently prohibit Crabbox from deleting workspaces?
rationale: The current automatic workspace lifecycle cannot atomically constrain Orgo's cascading deletion to resources Crabbox owns, so a permanent user-visible ownership contract must be selected before implementation can safely proceed.

options.title: Require managed workspace
options.body: Require a configured workspace, persist recovery around every mutation, and create or delete only exact claim-bound computers.

options.title: Defer built-in support
options.body: Keep the provider unmerged until Orgo exposes conditional or non-cascading workspace deletion primitives.

options.title: Keep integration external
options.body: Decline the built-in provider and leave Orgo support to an external or custom integration.

recommendation.title: Require managed workspace
recommendation.body: Require a configured workspace, persist recovery around every mutation, and create or delete only exact claim-bound computers.
